topic.title: Password Generator
topic.description: Generates a random password with a user-specified number of letters, symbols, and numbers. Offers easy (ordered) and hard (shuffled) modes.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using random.choice to pick characters, building lists, and using random.shuffle() followed by str.join() to combine.
learningNotes.challenges: Converting a list of characters to a string using join().
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add password strength evaluation and save to file.

files.description: Password generator with easy and hard (shuffled) modes.
